text.p: Typhoon Zane, with 120 mph winds, is nearly stationary, centered about 75 miles northwest of Okinawa, Japan. Zane is expected to weaken during the next 48 hours with top winds dropping to under 100 mph by the end of the forecast period. During this time, Zane is expected to begin to move to the east, passing north of Okinawa, into the waters southeast of Japan. Zane will continue to be a significant threat to shipping.

Typhoon Yates, with 120 mph winds, is currently centered about 115 miles west of Iwo Jima, moving north northeast at 12 mph. Yates is expected to continue this motion into the open waters of the western Pacific as top winds drop to under 100 mph during the next 48 hours. This system will continue to be a significant threat to shipping through this forecast period.

Hurricane Isidore, 1400 miles south southwest of the Azores, will move northeast to north and weaken to a tropical storm during the next 36 hours as top winds drop from 75 mph to near 55 mph. Isidore will remain over open water and will be a threat only to shipping southwest to west of the Azores.

Tropical Storm Genevieve will move westward in the open eastern Pacific along 15n from 117w to near 123w this period, as top winds increase from near 50 mph to near 65 mph. Genevieve will be an increasing threat to shipping.
